text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Paging eng-oncall: p99 latency spike detected in continuous-batching streaming path (us-west2). p95 ~1.8s -> 4.9s, p99 ~2.3s -> 6.7s. Impacting streaming clients and long-tail inference; ~12% increase in tail time, multiple customer errors. Pager: @tanvi @jeff @maria. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/contbatch-tail

tanvi: I'm on it. Observed alerts show queues backing up on batcher-03 and batcher-07. Starting triage — looking at scheduler fairness and seqlen distribution.

jeff: noted. I saw increased KV eviction rates and a spike in streaming stalls in the past 10m. Could be mixed sequence-length amplification. Pulling traces.

maria: tagging infra: p99 paging => potential customer impact. Any known deploys? alex, did any rollout start ~10:10 UTC?

alex: no deploys in us-west2 in last hour. No config pushes either. I can repro load profile in staging with the current batcher config.

ops-bot: Automations: created incident Incident-3190012345, added pagerduty and oncall-escalation. Channel: #incidents. Notifying CS.

sam-cs: CS looped in. We have two customers on live pages (Acme and Nimbus). Requesting ETA on mitigation before we notify them.

jeff: pasted sample trace + small log snippet:

```
[2026-03-15T10:12:03Z] batcher-03 enqueue size=64 seqlens=[8,8,1024,12,9,...] schedule_delay_ms=45
[2026-03-15T10:12:03Z] kvcache_evict key=kv-usr-xxx evict_count=3 miss=0.22
[2026-03-15T10:12:03Z] streaming: stall detected client=stream-789 wait_ms=1200
```

jeff: pattern = small/very-large mixed seqlen in same batch -> padding/compute blowup and scheduler favoring large items. It's amplifying tail due to serialization within continuous batching slot.

tanvi: mitigations to try in parallel:
- temporarily disable continuous-batching for streaming route in us-west2 (fast rollback)
- reduce max_batch_size for streaming to 32
- enable seqlen-based bucketing (if safe) / promote smaller seqlen priority
- fallback routing to non-optimized model variant (lower throughput but predictable latency)

maria: +1. Start with config toggle (disable cont-batch) and reduce batch size. Those are lowest-risk. Alex, can you push the toggle to prod in us-west2?

alex: doing toggle now. deploy-bot: starting config change "contbatch.disable=us-west2.streaming=true" -> rolling to batcher-{01..10}

deploy-bot: config apply in progress: batcher-01 OK, batcher-02 OK, batcher-03 OK, batcher-04 OK, batcher-05 OK, batcher-06 OK, batcher-07 OK, batcher-08 OK, batcher-09 OK, batcher-10 OK

ops-bot: Config change applied. Continuous-batching disabled for streaming route in us-west2.

jeff: telemetry — within 90s after toggle p99 dropped from 6.7s -> 2.5s, p95 back to ~1.9s. Streaming stalls count decreased by ~78% on affected hosts. Looks like cont-batch was the amplifier.

sam-cs: will notify Acme + Nimbus: "We detected a transient latency issue impacting streaming. We've applied a mitigation and latency is improved; we're monitoring and will follow up with a root cause analysis." Want copy reviewed?

tanvi: LGTM. Next steps:
- keep toggle in place until we ship proper seqlen-bucketing + scheduler fairness fix
- run simulated load with mixed seqlen and iterate on max_batch_size in staging
- create postmortem and customer-impact timeline
- assign owners: jeff (root cause / runtime fix), alex (config rollout verification), maria (postmortem draft), sam-cs (customer comms)

jeff: I'll instrument per-batch seqlen histogram and add an alert for high seqlen-variance -> automatic shedding of large items into separate buckets.

maria: creating incident doc now: https://redwood.internal/incidents/3190012345

oncall-bot: Incident-3190012345 severity: Sev2. Pagerduty: acknowledged. Handoff scheduled in 45m. /remind ops in 20m to re-check p99

tanvi: updating on-call handoff notes: mitigated (cont-batch disabled), monitoring, owners assigned. If p99 creeps above 3s we escalate to infra.

alex: I'll run a targeted canary enabling seqlen-bucketing in staging and report back by +30m.

sam-cs: sent initial customer notif. Will update when we have RCA ETA. :white_check_mark:

jeff: quick follow-up: propose a short-term policy to cap max_batch_size for streaming to 48 across regions while we harden bucketing. Will open change request.

maria: good. Closing update for now — keep thread alive for postmortem links and customer follow-ups. Thanks team :props:
